issues: The summary, key points and quote all match the post: SQL Server 2025 is now generally available, the Standard and Express limits changed, Web edition is discontinued, and BC28 will support SQL Server 2025.
Key point 1 compares against earlier limits that the post never states. This is minor and not misleading.
The listed features are SQL Server edition changes rather than Business Central features. The post does describe them, so I kept them.
